briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and xAI Colossus accelerate AGI timeline amid compute arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with Orion and successor models posting rapid capability gains. US export controls tighten as China advances via DeepSeek and domestic chips. Regulatory focus sharpens on deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with multimodal reasoning surpassing prior benchmarks. Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Opus while Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4 compete on efficiency. xAI Colossus scales to 1T parameters in private testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates AI RMF with new red-teaming mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft and Google announce $40B data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. Energy constraints slow European GPU clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first company to reach 10^27 FLOP training runs trigger mandatory international oversight?
